description: Pre-indexed code knowledge graph, auto syncs on code changes, for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, OpenCode, AntiGravity, Kiro, CoPilot, and Hermes Agent — fewer tokens, fewer tool calls, 100% local
vibe: Deterministic graphs, surgical edits, and a single source of truth for every agent.
highlights: Extraction is deterministic — derived from AST, not LLM-summarized.
A derivation that two callers render must live in src/graph/, not in ToolHandler — two derivations eventually disagree.
Adding a 5th agent is one new file in targets/ + one entry in registry.ts.
Any new SQL or grammar wasm must be copied or it won't ship.
server-instructions.ts is the single source of truth for agent-facing guidance.
assessment: This file treats agent instructions as production infrastructure: it pins exact Node ranges, documents the two-vitest-project split and why it exists, and names the failure mode behind each rule (missing wasm = unhighlighted screen, duplicated derivations = drift). The insistence on deterministic AST extraction over LLM summarization, plus the 'one file + one registry entry' extension contract, shows a systems designer optimizing for reproducibility and low-friction contribution rather than cleverness.
